text:
ajay: Kicking off a quick triage thread for the BlueBay joint POC — partner asks: pilot timeline, security questionnaire status, and pricing for a shared/dedicated setup.

sophia_bb: Thanks Ajay. BlueBay legal sent over an initial security questionnaire (SSQ) and wants dedicated+VPC option for data residency. Can we confirm what we need from them?

maria: I can own the SSQ. Need their network CIDRs and SCIM/SAML metadata. Also ask if they need HSM or just KMS integration.

derek: For Dedicated vs Shared: pricing diff depends on committed GPUs and retention of KV cache. Quick rule of thumb: Dedicated ~= 3x hosted for SLO-backed throughput. I can pull a sample quote.

sophia_bb: They asked for a ballpark monthly for a 2xA100 equivalent reserved pool with 1TB KV cache persisted and 99.9% uptime SLA.

ajay: Derek, can you drop a quick ballpark we can share (even as private)? Also they want perf: 100 rps text-gen with 0.2s/token median at 512 tokens.

derek: Ballpark (very rough): $35k-$50k/mo depending on region and exact GPU sku + infra/network egress. For perf, 100 rps at 512 tokens probably needs autoscaled dedicated pool + batching/caching — we should run a stress sim.

sophia_bb: They also flagged compliance: ISO27001 and SOC2 are fine, but they want a sample audit report and data deletion SLA for pilot.

maria: I'll attach the SOC2 pack and a short note about data deletion (48h for ephemeral logs by default; customer can request longer retention for logs/metrics if needed). Ask if they need audit logs shipped to their SIEM.

lia: Quick technical blocker: BlueBay needs SSO before POC (they won't hand over sample data otherwise). We support SAML and OIDC; SCIM provisioning needs a small config. @deploy-bot can we get the SAML metadata template?

deploy-bot: SAML metadata template: 
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example/saml">
  <!-- upload cert, ACS URL, EntityID -->
</EntityDescriptor>
```

ajay: Great. Sophia — can BlueBay share IdP metadata and preferred provisioning (SCIM yes/no)? Also are they ok with using a redwood-managed KMS for pilot or require BYOK/HSM?

sophia_bb: They'll try redwood-managed KMS for pilot but may request BYOK for production. IdP metadata coming today. SCIM = yes.

derek: Action items for us: 1) I’ll create a pilot quote draft and perf sim runbook. 2) Maria will start SSQ answers and attach SOC2 pack. 3) Ajay/Lia will validate SAML/SCIM flow. 4) Ops: check network firewall egress IPs for VPC peering.

maria: Also advise partner they can start with hosted + private tenancy feature flags to prove flow, then migrate to Dedicated if perf/SLAs needed. Lower friction for initial sign-up.

sophia_bb: That helps. One last ask: can we get a 2-week trial of private tenant (no commit) to validate SSO + telemetry? Their procurement requires a short pilot window.

ajay: We'll try to accommodate — Derek, any internal blockers to granting a short private-tenant trial with limited capacity?

derek: Ops can spin an isolated private tenant for 2 weeks if they commit to a short runbook and pre-pay for baseline capacity. I'll sync with infra for IPs and quotas.

lia: I'll set a 1-hour enablement call with BlueBay for next Tue to walk SAML/SCIM and telemetry endpoints.

sophia_bb: Perfect — putting that in calendar. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

ajay: Thanks — I'll follow up with an internal checklist and assign owners. Will post the quote and SSQ draft here when ready.
